capture: json.Marshal of each public package Profile returned by newPackageAssessmentCatalog and newDictionaryPackageAssessmentCatalog at the published main baseline

profiles.NormativeClosure: Finite resource graph rooted in original XML or a direct current MusicXML/Opus model. The graph report has package target; plain XML/model boundaries do not assert ZIP/container obligations. Authorized nested raw MXL boundaries receive the selected applicable package checks. Source and current-model intrinsic interpretations are fixed separately. The selected sealed checks preserve exact container path, ordered rootfile and no-namespace musical-root evidence, reviewed first media-type cases, conditional score-before-parts and exact authorized instrument-part-file association. Local XSD/reference facts are prerequisites, not duplicated package datatype rules. Independent intrinsic source/model reports keep their own profiles, digests, targets and counts; successful target-kind evidence never certifies child conformance. Selected schema-hint namespace/location pairing is a capability policy separate from the accepted list(anyURI) datatype. Unmatched hints or missing discovery evidence prevent selected discovery completion; current models cannot reconstruct discarded xsi attributes and may remain incomplete even with no encoded outgoing links. No hinted schema is loaded or selected. Group, image scaling, mimetype presence/first placement/exact content, UTF-8 entry names and file/MIME conventions remain optional advice. Observed compression is capability context, not an invented DEFLATE-only rejection rule. Raw mimetype checks distinguish mandatory stored/unencrypted, local-header no-extra and reviewed leading padding/five standard Unicode BOM cases from optional exact content; central-only extras and other padding families remain explicit incomplete interpretation gates. Complete ZIP/JAR/DEFLATE normative closure, the complete MusicXML media-type set, outer compressed-rootfile and linked-target indirection and unproved association or role interpretations remain unresolved when reached. Bounded technical nested traversal does not resolve outer indirection wording. Missing authority, unavailable target/root/fragment evidence and incomplete graph enumeration cannot certify success. The fixed intrinsic table includes source Container/Sounds for selected auxiliary resources without adding Document model roots. MusicXML 4.0 identifies the pinned schema interpretation, not a blanket version=4.0 instance restriction. No filename-based role inference, cross-file ID equality, universal XPointer, renderer, dictionary, automatic network/filesystem access or full MusicXML conformance claim. Existing intrinsic syntax, unread-DTD, representation and resource limits remain active.
